green_summary.CodeKnowledgeInfra.v1: tools/infra/code-knowledge.mjs validate|qualify|up|probe. Exit contract 0=PASS / 1=input-or-prerequisite / 2=verification-failure (execution-contract V_INFRA_I05.cli_contract), fail-closed loads, displayPath/redactHostPaths on every structured field, no host paths in any receipt. validate checks all five domain files: lock component coverage/floating tag/digest format/auth-flag/upGate-closed, CodeWiki profile policies (selfhost-only, pinned-upstream-on-selection, manifest, freshness commit-pin, authenticated API/MCP readback), CodeGraph profile invariants (removable, no gate/knowledge authority, structure-only, commit-pin, fresh-pull rebuild, no autofeed to Outline/LLMWiki), repository-scope policies (deny-by-default, no public substitute, ingest-requires-authorization, per-entry project/immutableId/commit/grantRef), cross-project refs, JSON safety scan, compose declaration gate. qualify evaluates 10 evidence categories on the VERIFIED/RECORDED/UNVERIFIED ladder and exits 2 NOT_READY with per-category reasons; receipt binds sha256 of registry + all five domain files. up refuses through a gate chain: UP_REFUSED_IMAGES_LOCK_NOT_READY (2 unauthenticated components) -> UP_REFUSED_SOURCE_SCOPE_NOT_AUTHORIZED (deny-by-default, 0 authorized sources) -> UP_NOT_AUTHORIZED (closed upGate) -> UP_REFUSED_CONTAINER_DAEMON_UNREACHABLE (sandbox EPERM observed) -> UP_NOT_EXECUTED; no path to a fake launch. Probes are real subcommands: pinned-code-wiki evaluates a --manifest against the approved scope for real (freshness verdicts are facts; outer gate judges per policy) and genuinely attempts --endpoint reachability; graph-disabled-correctness re-runs the full main validation chain locally and reports the real violation count (exit 0 only when the chain is green).
green_summary.CodeWiki.v1: infra/delivery/code-knowledge/deepwiki-profile.json + repository-scope.json carry interface CodeWiki.v1. deepwiki-profile: service.kind=selfhost-deepwiki-open, publicHostedServiceSubstitute=false (flip = structural violation), upstream repository/commit/release/license null with status UNSELECTED (deepwiki-open upstream unselected — nothing fabricated; claiming SELECTED without a pinned commit is rejected), provider credentialRef=secret-ref:sdd-harness-pilot/codewiki-provider + sourceReadCredentialRef=secret-ref:sdd-harness-pilot/codewiki-source-read referenced only (noTokenBorrowing=true), generation.manifestRequired=true with freshness FAIL_CLOSED (maxCommitAgeDays=null, languageCoverageMin=null: undecided pilot language/repo-scale/update policy can never report pass), access.apiAuthRequired+mcpReadbackRequired=true. repository-scope: denyByDefault=true, approvedSources=[] (authorizationEvidence UNAUTHORIZED — grants must be issued by authorized principals, this task does not self-sign), entry contract immutableID + 40-hex pinned commit + purpose-bound grantRef + project binding; foreign project entries, unpinned commits, missing immutableIds and missing grantRefs are each rejected with distinct codes.
green_summary.CodeGraph.v1: infra/delivery/code-knowledge/graph-profile.json carries interface CodeGraph.v1: enabled=false (DISABLED) as the committed state, removableOptimization {removable=true, gateAuthority=false, knowledgeAuthority=false} (any authority flip or removability removal is a structural violation), source.structureOnly=true with inputCommitPinRequired=true and coverage.requiredFields [inputCommit, filesIndexed, languages, symbols] (status UNVERIFIED — requires a live component; not claimed while disabled), lifecycle {separateLifecycleFromWiki=true, rebuildRequiresFreshPull=true, noAutoFeedOutlineOrLlmWiki=true}. Correctness independence is enforced by the real local probe: graph-disabled-correctness re-executes the main validation chain and exits 0 only when green with graph disabled; the enabled=true fixture proves orthogonality (chain stays green either way).
